title: Prometeo full-potential architecture expansion
purpose: Use many independent fresh chats to deepen all major Prometeo layers in parallel instead of serializing the full architecture through one parent conversation.

launch_policy.launch_after: B-ZEROMEM-01 passes durable STARTED -> RETURN -> DONE -> parent observation
launch_policy.reason_for_gate: Only the generic worker transport is under test. The research/architecture scopes themselves are independent and already prepared.
launch_policy.parallelism: Launch all or most scouts nearly concurrently after canary PASS; they are isolated read/analysis jobs writing only their own run/return subtree.

completion_rule: All returns are evidence/candidates. Parent/steward performs a coverage reconciliation against Big Picture Map + Survival Set and compiles a vNext architecture/method plan before large shared implementation changes.

WI-BIG-01.title: Constitution + Active Method + METHOD_HEAD
WI-BIG-01.purpose: Recover and design the governing stack so stored memory actually controls future behavior and no useful method clauses silently disappear.

WI-BIG-02.title: Written Mind + Product Memory + Book/Canon/Forge
WI-BIG-02.purpose: Design expansive durable memory, compaction into Canon and gated execution without confusing FOCUS with full memory.

WI-BIG-03.title: Context Foundry + Source Plane + Working Set
WI-BIG-03.purpose: Recover and design RAW SOURCE -> SOURCE CARD -> RETRIEVAL -> WORKING SET -> COMPILED PROGRAM with freshness/privacy/evidence.

WI-BIG-04.title: Project North -> Campaign -> Run + Campaign Controller
WI-BIG-04.purpose: Design long-lived campaigns, phases/gates/checkpoints/adaptive depth so human mental scheduling disappears.

WI-BIG-05.title: Planner/Compiler + automatic decomposition
WI-BIG-05.purpose: Compile goals into dependency-aware prepared jobs, critics, scopes, return contracts and parallel batches.

WI-BIG-06.title: Agent Network vNext + nervous system
WI-BIG-06.purpose: Map how EPOCH/network/convergence/packets should evolve for Chat Objects, campaigns, work items and derived control state without becoming authority.

WI-BIG-07.title: Worker execution fabric + retries/stale/missed launch
WI-BIG-07.purpose: Design robust lifecycle, generic run allocation, stale detection, retries/supersession and one-worker-one-return execution.

WI-BIG-08.title: Control Room + parent awareness + event-driven orchestration
WI-BIG-08.purpose: Design derived partial/full worker/batch awareness and event/state refresh so parent keeps working and notices when integration is ready.

WI-BIG-09.title: Steward/Merger + authority + integration ledger
WI-BIG-09.purpose: Design canonical convergence of parallel returns with Current/Human Accepted/Served separation, conflict resolution and consumption states.

WI-BIG-10.title: Reincarnation + Public Wake + successor exams
WI-BIG-10.purpose: Recover SESSION_RETURN/rehydration/Public Wake/Reincarnation Exam/Cognitive Portrait and define proofs that fresh successors recover method + state, not just facts.

WI-BIG-11.title: Portable checkpoints + ZIP + rollback/update heads
WI-BIG-11.purpose: Recover release/work-checkpoint/successor-carrier architecture, target vs working head, rollback, receipts and external-model portability.

WI-BIG-12.title: Deep work + Challenger + 4X + Apprentice + traceability
WI-BIG-12.purpose: Compose historical deep-work method, critics, adaptive depth, reconstruction tests and requirement->decision->change->test traceability.

WI-BIG-13.title: Goldens + Vaccines + incidents + chaos/falsification
WI-BIG-13.purpose: Design durable success references, regression vaccines, negative phenotypes, incident learning and falsifying/chaos tests.

WI-BIG-14.title: Prompt OS + Cognitive Programs + Recipes
WI-BIG-14.purpose: Treat prompts as compilation targets from Constitution/Method/Campaign/Role/Working Set and recover reusable cognitive programs.

WI-BIG-15.title: FABRIC + Mission/Prompt/Airlock + product-host integration
WI-BIG-15.purpose: Recover host/product boundaries, identity/bytes/containment, admission/apply/update authority and ensure Chat Objects/workers extend rather than bypass them.

WI-BIG-16.title: Universal AI entry + security/capabilities/privacy
WI-BIG-16.purpose: Design machine-readable public bootstrap, discovery, signatures/versioning, narrow capability tokens, public/private boundaries and safe unrelated-AI participation.

WI-BIG-17.title: Multi-project/Chat-Object graph + Assembly Surface/human UX
WI-BIG-17.purpose: Design umbrella projects, multiple durable Chat Objects/campaigns/shared owners plus future control surface while keeping ChatGPT-native zero-memory UX minimal.

WI-BIG-18.title: Compaction/convergence + crystallized intelligence + anti-limitation audit
WI-BIG-18.purpose: Design durable deduplication/promotion/retirement/coverage audit and explicitly identify assumptions that make Prometeo artificially smaller or more sequential than necessary.

worker_write_rule: Each scout writes only its own run/return subtree. No scout may mutate shared architecture, runtime, Work Board, Big Picture Map or Survival Set.
parent_after_batch: Read all returns without human copy/paste.
Recover concrete historical mechanisms cited by scouts where needed.
Run coverage audit against BIG_PICTURE_MAP_V1 + SURVIVAL_SET_V1.
Only then generate next implementation batches, maximizing parallel safe work.
